cohort: 388 pregnant women with pregestational or gestational diabetes who delivered at 37 weeks or later and had a third-trimester sonographic examination
finding: In pregnant women with diabetes, performing the gestation-adjusted projection method for fetal weight estimation at 34-36 weeks 6 days provided better accuracy compared to performing it at 31-33 weeks 6 days.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight: early group = 3303 g, late group = 3426 g
